metadata.description: Cost-schedule replay: the main backtest's trades (same signals, entry/exit dates and daily mark-to-market paths) re-sized and re-costed under five archetypal cost schedules (pairs_trading/fund_profiles.py). The schedules are illustrative parameter sets, not any firm's terms; the replay does not model margin, and max_gross_leverage reports the peak gross exposure actually run.

field_notes.drawdowns: all drawdown fields are <= 0, relative to the running peak; the starting capital counts as the first peak
field_notes.profit_factor: sum of winning trades / |sum of losing trades|; null when there is no losing trade (infinite) or no trade at all

quant_hf.description: Systematic stat-arb archetype: electronic execution, large positions

multi_strat.description: Multi-manager pod archetype: blended execution, pass-through costs

institutional.description: Pension-style archetype: patient algorithmic execution, no leverage

retail.description: Retail or small proprietary account archetype: expensive borrow and margin
